{{Quote|Listen to me. I don't know who you are, but I am in possession of a very special set of skills. If you bring my sister back right now, unharmed, then I'll let you go. But if you don't, I promise you, I will track you down. I will find you. And I will make you pay.|Rojo Trace telepathically warns his sister's abductor|<ref name="RH" />}}
'''Rojo Trace''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and was also the brother of [[Hestizo Trace]].

==Biography==
While investigating a crash of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] starship on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[3645 BBY]], Rojo Trace received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] that his sister was in danger on the planet [[Marfa]]. He immediately traveled there to find that she had been attacked and kidnapped by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Tulkh]]. Tulkh had stolen the [[Murakami orchid]] and Rojo knew that his sister [[Hestizo Trace|Hestizo]], a member of the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], was its guardian as the flower was very [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Trace then pursued leads as to where Tulkh may be headed and he found out from a drunken [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] smuggler, called [[Gree (smuggler)|Gree]], that Tulkh had been hired by [[Darth Scabrous]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]]. Trace immediately left for Odacer-Faustin and discovered that the planet had been overrun by Sith [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] creatures. However, he knew that Hestizo was still alive.<ref name="RH" />

After quickly dueling [[Sith Blademaster]] [[Shak'Weth]], he eventually pin-pointed her location in the library. He entered to find that the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] librarian, [[Dail'Liss]], had been bitten by Scabrous who was carrying the disease. The Neti had gone insane and had started burning all of the library's scrolls and [[Holobook/Legends|holobooks]]. After being captured by the Neti and seeing his memories of his discovery of the Sith temple beneath the library, Trace was able to escape and go after Hestizo. He found her as the zombified Scabrous was ready to kill her. He engaged Scabrous in a duel but Scabrous killed him using mind manipulation and an ancient [[Sith sword]], cutting him nearly in half.<ref name="RH" />

==Powers and abilities==
An able lightsaber duelist, Trace was versed in the fifth form of lightsaber combat; [[Form V/Legends|Djem So]]. His skill was advanced enough that he could temporarily hold his own against such opponents as the Sith Blademaster Shak'Weth or Darth Scabrous.<ref name="RH" />

Trace's primary talent was his [[Psychometry/Legends|telemetric abilities]], which led to him being frequently called on to serve as an investigator.<ref name="RH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rojo Trace is based on [[Liam Neeson]]'s character Bryan Mills from [[Wikipedia:Taken (film)|''Taken'']].<ref name="Joe">{{Suvudu|subdomain=star-wars|url=2010/12/take-five-with-joe-schreiber-author-star-wars-red-harvest.html|text=Take Five with Joe Schreiber, Author, "Star Wars: Red Harvest"|author=Matt Stags|date=2010-12-21}}</ref>
